description: This PHP class defines the ProjectLocation model, which extends a LocationItem class and manages location-related data for projects within the Goteo platform. It includes methods for retrieving location data, and permission checks for viewing and editing based on user roles.

classes.name: ProjectLocation
classes.description: Represents the location associated with a project, with permission checks for viewing and editing based on user roles.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a ProjectLocation object, calling the parent constructor and setting the project ID.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the location data for a given project object or ID.

methods.name: userCanView
methods.description: Checks if a user has permission to view the project location, based on project view permissions.

methods.name: userCanEdit
methods.description: Checks if a user has permission to edit the project location, based on project edit permissions.
